;Arts and culture
*[[71st Primetime Emmy Awards]]
**''[[Fleabag]]'' wins [[Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Comedy Series|Outstanding Comedy Series]] and ''[[Game of Thrones]]'' wins [[Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Drama Series|Outstanding Drama Series]] at the 71st Primetime Emmy Awards. [https://www.cnbc.com/2019/09/22/emmys-2019-the-complete-list-of-winners-and-nominees.html (CNBC)]
;Disasters and accidents
*At least 22 people are killed and 15 others injured after a bus rams into a hill ''en route'' from [[Skardu]] to [[Rawalpindi]], [[Pakistan]], following a brake failure. [https://news.sky.com/story/at-least-22-killed-after-bus-rams-into-hill-following-brake-failure-11816591 (Sky News)]
*Two minibuses collide head-on near [[Limpopo]], [[South Africa]]. All eleven on board the vehicles die. [https://www.enca.com/news/11-killed-horror-head-collision-limpopo (ENCA)]
*[[Search and rescue]] aircraft locate wreckage near [[Ilaga, Indonesia|Ilaga]], [[Indonesia]]. It is thought to be a missing [[Twin Otter]] cargo plane carrying rice and four people, but this remains to be confirmed. [http://avherald.com/h?article=4ccf9902&opt=0 (The Aviation Herald)]
*A classroom collapses in [[Dagoretti]], [[Kenya]], killing at least seven children. [https://www.standardmedia.co.ke/article/2001342979/two-pupils-killed-several-injured-as-classroom-wall-collapses-in-dagoretti (''The Standard'')]
;Health and environment
*[[Car-Free Days|World Car-Free Day]]
**Cities around the world celebrate World Car-Free Day. [https://www.urdupoint.com/en/world/factbox-world-carfree-day-717540.html (UrduPoint)]
**[[Brussels]] reports up to 70% lower levels of [[nitrogen dioxide]] and [[black carbon]] in the atmosphere, compared to other Sundays. [https://www.hln.be/in-de-buurt/brussel/-tot-70-minder-stikstof-en-dieselroet-bij-autovrije-zondag-brussel~a1a501aa/ (Belga via ''Het Laatste Nieuws'')]
**Over {{convert|12|miles}} of roads are closed for traffic in [[central London]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/cities/gallery/2019/sep/22/world-car-free-day-2019-in-pictures (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Climate change mitigation]]
**[[Federal Ministry of the Environment, Nature Conservation and Nuclear Safety|German Environment Minister]] [[Svenja Schulze]] says the [[euro|€]]54 billion [[Climate change mitigation|climate]] plan approved by the [[Fourth Merkel cabinet|German cabinet]] on Friday enables her country to join the [[Powering Past Coal Alliance]]. Germany expects to [[Coal#Transition_away_from_coal|transition away from coal]] by 2038. [https://www.dw.com/en/germany-to-join-alliance-to-phase-out-coal/a-50532921 (Deutsche Welle)]
*[[Effects of global warming]]
**The [[World Meteorological Organization]] publishes a report stating that 2015–2019 was the [[Global warming|hottest five-year period]] since measurements began. The increase in the [[Carbon dioxide in Earth's atmosphere|global carbon dioxide level]], the [[Sea level rise|rise of the sea level]] and the melting of [[ice caps]] is accelerating. [https://www.breakingnews.ie/world/climate-change-causes-and-impacts-are-accelerating-experts-warn-952345.html (PA via breakingnews.ie)]
;Law and crime
*[[Crisis in Venezuela]]
**Argentina accuses Venezuela of committing "crimes against humanity", "torture and murder" after receiving reports from Venezuelan refugees in the country. The Argentine Government will file a formal accusation against Venezuela before the [[International Court of Justice]]. [https://www.clarin.com/mundo/torturas-ejecuciones-desapariciones-forzadas-crudo-informe-gobierno-argentino-abusos-regimen-venezuela_0_rpFqgDFJ.html (''Clarín'')]
*[[Brexit]]
**[[Dominic Raab]] says the [[Government of the United Kingdom|UK Government]] will abide by the upcoming [[Supreme Court of the United Kingdom|Supreme Court]]'s ruling on the lawfulness of [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|Prime Minister]] [[Boris Johnson]]'s [[Prorogation in the United Kingdom#Boris Johnson (2019)|prorogation]] of [[Parliament of the United Kingdom|Parliament]]. When asked if the Government would prorogue Parliament again if it wins, he answers that he's "keen not to take levers off the table that weaken the position of the UK in Brussels". [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-49786644 (BBC News)]
*[[Sudan]]ese Prime Minister [[Abdalla Hamdok]] launches an investigation into the deaths of dozens of protestors during a July crackdown orchestrated under the regime of now-ousted President [[Omar al-Bashir]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/20190922-sudan-hamdock-investigation-protest-deaths-violence (France 24)]
;Politics and elections
*The [[Joint List]] recommends [[Benny Gantz]] as the next [[Prime Minister of Israel]]. This is the first time an [[Arab citizens of Israel|Arab]]-led political party recommends a candidate for prime minister since they recommended [[Yitzhak Rabin]] in [[1992 Israeli legislative election|1992]]. [https://www.axios.com/israel-netanyahu-gantz-arab-joint-list-odeh-efce1338-2aaf-4c61-97a3-05d08477b506.html (Axios)]
